PyTorch packing consumes valid prefixes, so first compact each left-padded history into chronological, right-padded form: `[0,0,a,b,c] → [a,b,c,0,0]`. Pack only nonempty rows using CPU lengths and `batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=False`. Unpack with `total_length=L`; scatter compact output timestep `j` back to original position `L−length+j`, leaving padding outputs zero. This preserves alignment with timestep-specific training targets and diagnostic masks. Packing the original left-padded tensor instead processes padding and truncates real events. [Packing documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence.html).

For a unidirectional GRU, top-layer `h_n[-1]` represents the final valid recurrent state. Automatic sorting restores both unpacked outputs and returned hidden states to input batch order; do not unsort them again. If sorting manually, explicitly invert that permutation. After scattering to left-padded coordinates, read the final nonpadding position—`L−1` for every nonempty strictly left-padded row—not `length−1`. Filter empty histories before packing and explicitly assign their documented fallback, such as zero features; clamping lengths to one executes a synthetic padding timestep. [Unpacking documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence.html), [recurrent implementation](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/torch/nn/modules/rnn.py).

Recommended equivalence checks: in evaluation mode, with identical weights and initial states, compare every valid scattered timestep and final hidden state against separate unpadded GRU executions, using numerical tolerance. Include unsorted/tied lengths, singleton/full histories, mixed/all-empty batches, batch permutations, and added left padding. Verify padding outputs are zero and candidate scores remain invariant to padding width and batch companions. If recurrence outputs match but diagnostic readouts fail, investigate indexing/scattering; if valid states change with padding, investigate compaction or unintended padding recurrence.
